name: Decypharr VOD
description: Imports Decypharr media as native Dispatcharr VOD with a normalized .strm library, TMDB genre categories, reliable background scanning, refresh protection for the synthetic XC account, FFprobe metadata, artwork, and optional hardware-accelerated browser transcoding.
author: Tw1zT3d2four7

fields.label: Preferred Audio Language
fields.help_text: Preferred audio language when multiple tracks exist. If unavailable, the source default track is used, then the first available track. Direct-play sources are not remuxed just to change the default.

fields.label: Fast Initial Scan
fields.help_text: Build the playable catalog first without remote FFprobe/TMDB probing. Metadata, genres, artwork and technical details are enriched afterward in small background batches.

fields.label: Metadata Enrichment Batch Size
fields.help_text: Titles enriched per background pass. Lower values minimize impact on active VOD playback.

fields.label: Progressive Import Batch Size
fields.help_text: Number of discovered media items imported at a time during the initial scan.

fields.label: Decypharr API Workers
fields.help_text: Parallel Decypharr inventory requests. Lower values reduce network pressure on active playback.

fields.label: About Browser Transcoding
fields.help_text: Browsers cannot play many common files: HEVC/x265, HDR10, and Dolby or DTS audio. In the Dispatcharr web player these start, stall, or freeze even though the stream is healthy. When enabled, the plugin checks each file the web player opens and converts only files the browser cannot play into H.264/AAC on the fly. Files a browser already plays, and every other app (VLC, Emby, Jellyfin, TiviMate, Kodi), are never transcoded. Seeking is limited while transcoding.

fields.label: Browser Transcoding
fields.help_text: Only used by the Dispatcharr web player, and only for files the browser cannot play. Off by default.

fields.label: Transcode Encoder
fields.help_text: Auto tests NVIDIA, Intel, then AMD/VAAPI and falls back to CPU.

actions.label: Scan Decypharr
actions.description: Scan Decypharr API and update the normalized presentation library. Automatic background scanning also runs at the configured interval.

actions.label: Repair Integration
actions.description: Reinstall routes and relation hooks and ensure the synthetic account exists.

actions.label: Test Transcoding
actions.description: Test which hardware encoders (NVIDIA, Intel, AMD/VAAPI) or the CPU can transcode on this system.

actions.label: Clean VOD Database
actions.description: Delete the VOD objects and relations, then immediately verify that the VOD tables are empty. The M3U accounts are preserved.
